name: Cheese Bank LP oracle priced from spot pair reserves
summary: CheesePriceOracle.fetchLPAnchorPrice() values a Uniswap V2 LP token as `wETH.balanceOf(pair) * 2 * ethPrice / pair.totalSupply()`, a single-block spot read of the pair's WETH balance. Every non-LP asset in the same contract is priced through fetchAnchorPrice(), which reads Uniswap's cumulative-price accumulator over a TWAP window; the LP branch has no accumulator, no window and no sanity band. refresh() is permissionless, so an attacker could swap 20,000 ETH into the CHEESE/WETH pair, call refresh in the same transaction to write the inflated LP price into `prices`, and then borrow against LP collateral through the Comptroller's ordinary borrow() checks.

loss.notes: Reconstructed from the exploit receipt, not from reporting. Logs 193, 197 and 201 are the three Cheese Bank markets paying the attacker contract: 2068252649482 USDC units from 0x5e181bdde2fa8af7265cb3124735e9a13779c021, 1237995403809 USDT units from 0x4c2a8a820940003cfe4a16294b239c8c55f29695 and 87586864453785145669360 DAI wei from 0xa80e737ded94e8d2483ec8d2e52892d9eb94cf1f. All three are par-valued dollar stablecoins. The 21000 ETH dYdX flash loan and the 50 ETH used to buy CHEESE are attacker-supplied inputs and are not loss. Cheese Bank retained the 2833.226849227665 CHEESE/WETH UNI-V2 LP tokens the attacker had deposited into market 0x7e4956688367fb28de3c0a62193f59b1526a00e7 at log 180, but that collateral was itself attacker-supplied and, once the 20000 ETH manipulation swap was unwound inside the same transaction, worth a small fraction of the stablecoins removed, so the gross depletion is reported without netting it. No ETH-denominated market paid out in this transaction.

ageReset.description: CheesePriceOracle is a non-upgradeable contract created directly by an EOA, with its whole TokenConfig array fixed in constructor arguments and no implementation slot or delegatecall. Its runtime hashes to 0xa648fc87e532b50bfa445cb5ac06ee5d0a7a41f68abaec48c48d4a6d98edc500 both at the creation block 11061144 and at block 11205647 immediately before the exploit.

sources.note: Anchor: EOA 0x882d72aaae187f54e85c7a0cb19dfec5316cd9aa has exactly three mainnet transactions; the first deploys the attack contract 0x9e0259437804c7bf175421a451bc80611a0b93c3 at block 11205639 and the second, 0x600a869aa3a259158310a233b815ff67ca41eab8961a49918c2031297a02f1cc at 11205648:106, timestamp 1604690541, status 1, is the whole campaign in one transaction, so it is both the earliest and the only defect-executing success. Root cause read from the Etherscan-verified CheesePriceOracle source at 0x833e440332caa07597a5116fbb6163f0e15f743d: fetchLPAnchorPrice computes `wEthBalance = wETH.balanceOf(config.uniswapMarket); pairBalance = wEthBalance * 2; totalValue = pairBalance * ethPrice; anchorPrice = totalValue / pair.totalSupply()`, whereas fetchAnchorPrice for every non-LP asset goes through pokeWindowValues and Uniswap's price accumulator. Boundary test applied explicitly: the manipulable quantity is the pair's live WETH balance, which is read inside the same transaction as the borrow, so no value of any TokenConfig field, anchor period, collateral factor or reporter set makes the LP branch correct; the only configuration that avoids the loss is not listing an LP market at all. The defect is therefore executable code and not a parameter. The oracle is called 13 times in the anchor trace, once by CALL (refresh) and twelve times by STATICCALL from the Unitroller/Comptroller path 0xde2289695220531dfcf481fe3554d1c9c3156ba3 -> 0x3c7274679ff9d090889ed8131218bdc871020391. Code history: Etherscan getcontractcreation puts the oracle at 11061144:63 in 0xe43a7dba24b95680f60c1ab82531705b86b63f38f8c7d5596dabcd84ab35c286 created by 0xf3a40b251d5b0b0eb2908b10bbf5dd7e717f897e, timestamp 1602775046; eth_getCode at block 11061144 and at block 11205647 both hash to 0xa648fc87e532b50bfa445cb5ac06ee5d0a7a41f68abaec48c48d4a6d98edc500, the contract exposes no upgrade path, so codeAgeSeconds = 1604690541 - 1602775046 = 1915495 (22.17 d). Loss taken from the receipt's ERC20 Transfer logs out of the three borrow markets, totalling 3393834.917744785145669360 dollars of par-valued stablecoins.

notes: Which oracle the Comptroller consults is configuration, but the defect measured here is inside the deployed oracle's own LP pricing function, so the oracle's deployment is the executable-code age basis and the market listing and collateral factors are context.
